name: Rhys
aliases: Daen Rhys of the Hemlock pack
description: Rhys is a Gilt-Leaf elf hunter from Lorwyn, a former commander of the Hemlock pack who helped defeat Oona and was bound by a death pact to Maralen.

description_citations.text: "Rhys". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

summary.text: Rhys is a Gilt-Leaf elf hunter from Lorwyn, a former commander of the Hemlock pack who helped defeat Oona and was bound by a death pact to Maralen.

citations.text: "Rhys". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

bio.text: Colfenor took Rhys as his apprentice and taught him yew magic.

citations.text: "Colfenor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: After a raid on boggarts failed, Rhys was demoted and Gryffid took command of the Hemlock pack.

citations.text: "Rhys", section "Demotion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Overwhelmed by feral boggarts at the Feast of Footbottom, Rhys invoked Colfenor's magic in a poison blast that killed everyone except himself, Gryffid and Nath, and he was branded a kin-slayer, traitor and outlaw.

citations.text: "Rhys", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Rhys", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Colfenor asked him to plant his seed cone in the Murmuring Bosk, and Rhys later killed Nath at Kinsbaile.

citations.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: After the Great Aurora turned the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeated Oona.

citations.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Maralen became queen of the fae and bound Rhys to her, granting him immortality on condition that he poison her if Oona returned.

citations.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Decades later, Oko manipulated Rhys into believing Maralen was becoming Oona, and Rhys struck her with moonglove.

citations.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Oko cured Maralen with dawnglow, Rhys was freed from the pact, thanked Eirdu and Maralen, and dissolved into flower petals.

citations.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

status.text: Rhys is dead, having dissolved into flower petals once his pact with Maralen ended.

citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.
"Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling meets Rhys and Maralen, who is later revealed to be a fae duplicate bearing a piece of Oona's soul.
timeline.quote: Maralen was a fae duplicate

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Festival of Tales Gilt-Leaf soldiers ambush the party; Ashling repels the arrows with fire.
timeline.quote: Ashling protected her new friends valiantly

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gaddock Teeg assigns Brigid to accompany Ashling in finding the Gilt-Leaf elf Rhys.
timeline.quote: Brigid became embroiled in an increasingly complex adventure when Gaddock Teeg assigned her to accompany a flamekin messenger named Ashling on her mission to find a Gilt-Leaf elf named Rhys .

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teeg orders Brigid to capture Rhys as a gift for the Gilt-Leaf commander Nath.
timeline.quote: Teeg ordered Brigid to capture Rhys and bring him back as a gift to Nath.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Manipulated by Colfenor's message, Brigid nearly drowns Ashling and attacks Rhys at the Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: Brigid nearly drowned Ashling on the banks of the Murmuring Bosk to snuff out her fire, attacked Rhys, and escaped to Kinsbaile with an unconscious, dying Ashling in tow.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys kills Nath, ending the elvish threat, and Colfenor admits he ordered Brigid's attack to coincide with his rebirth.
timeline.quote: the elvish threat to Kinsbaile was negated when Rhys killed Taercenn Nath in hand-to-hand combat

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4520 AR Gryffid, second-in-command of Rhys's Hemlock pack, warns him against nonstandard tactics in a raid on boggarts; Rhys is stripped of rank and Gryffid becomes pack leader.
timeline.quote: Gryffid was elevated to leader of their pack.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid leads the assault on a boggart feast in Porringer Valley; Rhys's yew magic backfires, killing most elves; Gryffid is one of three survivors, left an eyeblight.
timeline.quote: Gryffid was one of only three survivors from the ill-fated attack and was discovered by Nath.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath offers Gryffid a choice; Gryffid swears allegiance to Nath, becomes his second-in-command, and they agree to eliminate Rhys.
timeline.quote: Gryffid swore allegiance to Nath and became his second-in-command.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Festival of Tales they ambush Rhys in Kinsbaile; Rhys escapes and Gryffid is banished by Maralen's magic.
timeline.quote: was quickly banished from the battlefield by Maralen's magic.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys kills Nath; Gryffid finds the corpse, arranges a funeral pyre and swears vengeance on Rhys.
timeline.quote: ending with Nath's death at the hands of the outlaw traitor.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid comes to respect his new commander Eidren and hunts Rhys until the Great Aurora; when he catches Rhys, Eidren offers Rhys a return to the Gilt-Leaf.
timeline.quote: When he finally caught Rhys, Eidren dismissed Gryffid and made Rhys an offer to return to the Gilt-Leaf

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen becomes queen of the fae and binds Rhys to her, granting him immortality.
timeline.quote: Maralen took on the mantle of queen of the fae and bound herself to Rhys, granting him immortality

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys is demoted after his ambush on a boggart party fails, and Gryffid takes command of the Hemlock pack.
timeline.quote: command of the Hemlock pack was handed over to his friend Gryffid

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Demotion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath orders an attack on the Feast of Footbottom despite Rhys' report that it is a peaceful festival.
timeline.quote: Nath, with a cold smile, ordered to attack anyway

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Demotion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overwhelmed by feral boggarts, Rhys invokes Colfenor's magic, causing a poison blast that kills everyone except himself, Gryffid and Nath.
timeline.quote: the result was a ruinous blast of poison that eradicated the forest and killed everyone except Rhys, Gryffid, and Nath

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys meets Maralen, realizes the blast destroyed his horns, and lets her glamer him.
timeline.quote: Begrudgingly, Rhys allowed Maralen to bestow a glamer upon him that concealed his disfigurement.

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys is branded kin-slayer, traitor and outlaw by Nath and Gryffid.
timeline.quote: he was soon to be branded "kin-slayer", traitor, and outlaw by Nath and Gryffid

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brion and Kiel gather stories for Rosheen's birthday and give Rhys a scroll to deliver.
timeline.quote: entrusting him with a scroll of accumulated stories to deliver to Rosheen

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "The dream". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys, Maralen and her faeries find Rosheen asleep, surrounded by dancing changelings.
timeline.quote: eventually came upon Rosheen, who was in a deep sleep

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "The dream". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen's plan pulls them into Rosheen's sleep, producing a shared dreamscape.
timeline.quote: Maralen devised a plan to pull them all into Rosheen’s sleep

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "The dream". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dream map shows the plane sliding into darkness; Rhys ends the dream and Brion is killed by Gilt-Leaf forces.
timeline.quote: Shortly after, Brion was killed by Gilt-Leaf forces.

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "The dream". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Vendilion clique abducts Maralen; Sygg reaches the Bosk with Rhys, Ashling and Brigid.
timeline.quote: Sygg took the company through the Dark Meanders

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid attacks Ashling, ensnares Sygg and Rhys in a net, and Sygg frees them with acid.
timeline.quote: Sygg managed to free them both from the kithkin hero's trap

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The clique secretly spies on Rhys, Brigid and Maralen and reports to Oona.
timeline.quote: the trio was, in actuality, secretly spying on them and reporting their movements to Oona

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Assignment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys, blamed for a cataclysmic event that killed many elves and with his horns broken, is hunted by his society.
timeline.quote: He's being blamed for a cataclysmic event that killed many of his fellows.

citation.text: "Morningtide", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elves pull out all the stops to bring Rhys to their vicious brand of justice.
timeline.quote: they are pulling out all the stops to bring him to their vicious brand of justice.

citation.text: "Morningtide", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling, Brigid and the Vendilion clique find Rhys with a message from Colfenor.
timeline.quote: the flamekin carried a message for him

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor declares Rhys his final pupil and asks him to plant his seed cone in the Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: wishing for him to travel to the Murmuring Bosk and plant his seed cone there

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys finds the Bosk destroyed and plants the seedcone with an ancient blessing.
timeline.quote: Rhys planted the seedcone with a solemn reverence

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid, manipulated by Colfenor, lies about Ashling and Sygg and escapes to Kinsbaile with Ashling.
timeline.quote: Brigid, who was manipulated into the act by Colfenor, escaped to Kinsbaile with Ashling.

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath and Gryffid ambush the party at Kinsbaile and Nath challenges Rhys to a duel.
timeline.quote: Nath offered him a sword and challenged him to a duel

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys kills Nath by twisting his head by the horns until his neck snaps; the elves let him depart.
timeline.quote: Rhys grabbed Nath by his horns and twisted his head until his neck snapped

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and Colfenor burns to death as planned, promising to see Rhys again.
timeline.quote: the rekindling of Ashling by a greater elemental that she was seeking and the fiery demise of Colfenor

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A young treefolk rises at the Bosk a day after Colfenor's death.
timeline.quote: greeting them in the name of her seedfather

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The fae overwhelm Gilt-Leaf forces pursuing Rhys, and Maralen makes Gryffid and the rangers vanish in fog.
timeline.quote: the rest of the Gilt-Leaf rangers and their leader Gryffid simply vanished in a haze of fog

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor takes Rhys as apprentice and teaches him yew magic.
timeline.quote: Colfenor apprenticed a young Gilt-Leaf elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor meets Gaddock Teeg and retains Ashling to reach Rhys, while Oona's Vendilion clique spies on him.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Ashling with reaching his former apprentice, Rhys.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor and Rhys reunite in Kinsbaile, and Colfenor sends him to plant his seed cone at Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Rhys with traveling to Murmuring Bosk

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys, Ashling and Brigid find Murmuring Bosk leveled and burned, and Rhys plants the cone anyway.
timeline.quote: Rhys planted the cone anyway, performing a ritual to ensure its growth.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor learns Brigid was meant to capture Rhys and redirects her to abduct Ashling so as to end his own life.
timeline.quote: Colfenor covertly redirected Brigid to abduct Ashling instead.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys is trapped by his former tribesmen, fights and kills Taercenn Nath, and the siege of Kinsbaile is broken.
timeline.quote: Rhys emerged victorious, killing the ruthless Gilt-Leaf taercenn.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and her fire engulfs Colfenor, who dies as the last yew despite Rhys's efforts.
timeline.quote: the last yew burned brightly to his death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor's sapling rises one day after his death, greeting the company as her seedfather's heir.
timeline.quote: the young tree had grown, awakened, and "risen" merely one day after Colfenor's death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sapling plays a role in the Great Aurora and the war between Oona and Maralen but does not survive; a cutting is saved and revived as Ferrafor.
timeline.quote: The sapling would not survive the ensuing conflict

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Mistmeadow Gryffid sees fae carry Rhys away at Maralen's orders; Eidren sacrifices his life, and Gryffid brings his remains to Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: When Eidren sacrificed his life to protect Mistmeadow

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid's troops ambush Rhys, the Sapling and Ashling; Rhys talks him out of attacking and Gryffid hurries to protect Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: Rhys talked Gryffid out of attacking

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath punishes Daen Rhys for the failed boggart raid, kills Yelm, demotes Rhys and gives the Hemlock pack to Gryffid.
timeline.quote: He plunged his sword into the still-living skull of Yelm

citation.text: "Nath", section "Porringer Valley incident". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath orders the full Gilt-Leaf hunters to attack the boggarts at the Feast of Footbottom over Rhys's objections.
timeline.quote: Nath ordered the full strength of the Gilt-Leaf hunters to attack boggarts converging in the Porringer Valley

citation.text: "Nath", section "Porringer Valley incident". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The boggarts fight back; Rhys unleashes yew poison magic that wipes out nearly all combatants, leaving Rhys, Gryffid and Nath alive and Nath's glamer failed.
timeline.quote: The resulting blast defiled a huge portion of the forest and wiped out the combatants

citation.text: "Nath", section "Porringer Valley incident". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath and Gryffid come to Kinsbaile to ambush Rhys, planning to annex it.
timeline.quote: Nath and Gryffid came to Kinsbaile in pursuit of Rhys

citation.text: "Nath", section "Assault on Kinsbaile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nath challenges Rhys to a duel; Rhys flees, is wounded by the cuffhounds, and kills Nath in hand-to-hand combat, his glamer failing at death.
timeline.quote: Rhys emerged victorious when he gripped Nath's horns and twisted them

citation.text: "Nath", section "Assault on Kinsbaile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid finds Nath's body, sets up a funeral pyre, takes his silver sword and swears to kill Rhys.
timeline.quote: Gryffid set up a funeral pyre for Nath, took his silver sword

citation.text: "Nath", section "Assault on Kinsbaile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated at Glen Elendra with the sacrifice of the Sapling of Colfenor and the combined power of Maralen and Ashling's elemental; Maralen becomes queen of the fae as day returns.
timeline.quote: Maralen took her place as queen of the fae as day returned to the plane.

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen seeks Ashling's help as Oona's consciousness reasserts itself, bringing news of Isilu and Morcant's plot; they travel to Goldmeadow.
timeline.quote: Ashling was approached by Maralen in her time of crisis

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling and the others fight the Shadowmoor-afflicted kithkin and Gilt-Leaf elves; Rhys catches Maralen and fatally strikes her as their pact demanded.
timeline.quote: Rhys managed to catch up to Maralen and fatally struck her just as their pact had demanded of him.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko reveals he orchestrated the ordeal, falsely convinced Maralen and Rhys of Oona's return, and cures his sister.
timeline.quote: Making amends, he cured his sister, and the two were able to reconcile.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu reunite, rebalancing the plane's cycle; Rhys, freed of the pact's magic, dissolves into Eirdu's light.
timeline.quote: Ashling then watched as he dissolved into Eirdu's light.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the Sapling of Colfenor, and Rhys absorbs its poison.
timeline.quote: Oona killed the Sapling of Colfenor in a final act of spite

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling regains her power and sanity and joins Rhys against Oona.
timeline.quote: Restored to herself, Ashling joined Rhys in a final assault against Oona.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen meets Rhys in the Porringer Valley after his poison magic devastated the forest, and he agrees to take her toward Lys Alana.
timeline.quote: Nonetheless, he agreed to take her to the Gilt-Leaf capital, Lys Alana .

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The duplicate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sharing Rosheen's dreamscape, Maralen decides to defy Oona.
timeline.quote: Maralen awoke, freshly determined to defy the queen and greet the uncertain new world to do so.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The thorn princess". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen, with Rhys, Ashling and two elementals, destroys Oona and becomes queen of the fae.
timeline.quote: Oona was destroyed and wiped from the face of Lorwyn.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen gives Rhys the moonglove and instructs him to poison her at the first sign of Oona's return.
timeline.quote: Maralen gave the moonglove to Rhys and instructed him to poison her at the first sign of Oona's return

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys is granted eternal life until he can fulfill his oath.
timeline.quote: Rhys was granted eternal life until he was able to carry out his oath-sworn duty.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys raises Nath's broken horn and tells the hunters to keep Nath's true appearance from the Blessed Nation.
timeline.quote: Rhys, victorious on the field of battle, raised the taercenn's broken horn

citation.text: "Nath", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated by Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor's sapling, though her consciousness survives.
timeline.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her consciousness remains hidden

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Oona's defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen gives Rhys a moonglove flower to use on her if Oona returns through her, and Rhys becomes unable to die until then.
timeline.quote: until that day came, Rhys could never die

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Oona's defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko manipulates Rhys into believing Maralen is becoming Oona, and Rhys moves to strike her.
timeline.quote: He brandished his moonglow-tipped dagger against Maralen, but she escaped.

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys strikes Maralen with moonglove; Oko admits he roused Isilu and turned Rhys against her.
timeline.quote: Rhys struck her with the moonglove poison, ensuring her death

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko cures Maralen with dawnglow; Eirdu appears to offset Isilu and Rhys is at peace.
timeline.quote: Oko acquired a vial of dawnglow

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys declines a new oath, bids Maralen farewell, and fades into a shower of petals.
timeline.quote: his form faded beautifully into the wind as a shower of petals from across Lorwyn and Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Rhys and Ashling destroy Oona.
timeline.quote: destroyed Oona by a combination of poison, fire, and water magic.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Disbanding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Eventide team asks Creative which legends should appear, and the Sapling of Colfenor is concepted from the Lorwyn and Morningtide novels.
timeline.quote: The card Sapling of Colfenor arose from the Lorwyn and Morningtide novels, in which a strange new treefolk sapling grew from the seedcone of Rhys's old mentor, Colfenor.

timeline.summary: Tamira and Sanar find Maralen turning into Oona; Tamira makes Rhys miss his attack and Maralen enlists their help.

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Forty years later Oko returns and Maralen fears Oona's return; the siblings reconcile before Eirdu and Isilu.
timeline.quote: The siblings, rejoined for the first time in decades, reconciled in the presence of Eirdu and Isilu

citation.text: "Oona", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko protects Maralen and the students from elves, but Rhys wounds Maralen with a moonglow dagger.
timeline.quote: He was unable, however, to stop Maralen's retainer Rhys from wounding her

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen becomes queen of the fae and binds herself to Rhys with a death pact.
timeline.quote: Maralen took on the mantle of queen of the fae and bound herself to Rhys with a death pact.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys visits Maralen, who is reminded of the pact by which he would kill her if she followed Oona's path.
timeline.quote: Should she show any sign that her slow transformations had started to lead her down her creator's path, Rhys would kill her

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen briefly sees a third figure of living flower petals in her mirror and hears ghostly laughter, which Rhys cannot hear.
timeline.quote: it looked like there was a third person in the room with them, smaller, made entirely of living flower petals and glaring at her with unending menace.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys bursts in with the blue faerie and attacks Maralen with a dagger to keep his promise.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys slips on flower petals and tumbles out a window.
timeline.quote: Rhys took two wild, stumbling steps and tumbled out of a nearby window.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen explains the death pact and flees with Tam, Sanar and the blue faerie before Rhys returns.
timeline.quote: But I'm not ready to die, and if we can settle Isilu and restore the cycle, I may not have to.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen explains she keeps Rhys alive by magic through their binding promise.
timeline.quote: As long as he's bound to me, my magic keeps him alive.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.quote: I made your heir a promise. I made my friend a promise. This ends now.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The faerie drops to the ground, grows into a tall winged man and confronts Rhys, declaring Oona dead and Maralen his sister.
timeline.quote: Oona is dead. Maralen was my sister

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko recounts leaving Oona and mistaking Maralen for Oona reborn, and Rhys learns the poison has sealed her fate.
timeline.quote: His knife was coated in moonglow.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko turns more elves into rabbits to protect Sanar and tells Rhys that raising arms against day is raising them against night.
timeline.quote: She serves Lorwyn, and I serve Shadowmoor.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Kirol explains that dawnglove may counter moonglow, and Oko flies off to find Morcant.
timeline.quote: Don't let my sister die before I return,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko vows not to fail his sister and drips dawnglow into Maralen's mouth.
timeline.quote: What a cruel world, to force one such as I to play the hero,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko tells Rhys that Maralen is not Oona reborn and spares him, since Rhys thought he was destroying a tyrant.
timeline.quote: You thought you were destroying a tyrant, and that, at least, I can respect.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen forgives Rhys, but realizes his old promise is gone and he is no longer bound to her magic.
timeline.quote: Your old one—I can't feel it anymore. You're no longer bound to my magic.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys thanks Eirdu and Maralen, then dissolves into flower petals and dies.
timeline.quote: His body came apart in flower petals, dawnglove and moonglove and apple blossom

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen grants Rhys immortality on condition that he poison her if Oona's power corrupts her.
timeline.quote: she granted Rhys immortality on the condition that he must poison her should any hint arise that Oona's power is corrupting her.

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: A secret cutting of Colfenor's sapling is saved by Rhys and awakened by a special Rising as Ferrafor, the last yew treefolk.
timeline.quote: Awoken by a special version of the Rising, her first moments were of death and pain.

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Rhys is freed from his pact with Maralen and fades away into the daylight.
timeline.quote: then watched as Rhys was freed from the magical pact he had forged with Maralen decades ago and faded away into the daylight.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "Eclipsed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys strikes Maralen with a moonglove-poisoned blade to prevent Oona's return, leaving her dying.
timeline.quote: she was ultimately struck by Rhys with a moonglove-poisoned blade

citation.text: "Restoration of Balance", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys loses his bond to Maralen and dissolves.
timeline.quote: he allowed himself to dissolve

citation.text: "Restoration of Balance", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Forty years into her reign Oko returns and exploits Maralen's paranoia, betraying her fears to Rhys.
timeline.quote: but Oko betrayed her secret fears to Rhys

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Moonglove and Dawnglove". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Goldmeadow, Rhys cuts Maralen with moonglove poison, thinking he was freeing her from Oona.
timeline.quote: he sliced her with the moonglove poison, thinking he was freeing his old friend from Oona's clutches

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Moonglove and Dawnglove". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys is freed from his binding promise and dissolves into petals as Maralen embraces her brother.
timeline.quote: Maralen watched sorrowfully as Rhys dissolved into a flurry of moonglove and dawnglove petals.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Moonglove and Dawnglove". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam uses probability magic to make Rhys miss his attack on Maralen.
timeline.quote: but Tam used probability magic to make him miss his attack and fall out a window.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brion and Kiel help Rhys eliminate a boggart raiding party and agree to leave in exchange for stories for Rosheen.
timeline.quote: Brion and Kiel helped Rhys to eliminate a boggart raiding party.

citation.text: "Brion Stoutarm", section "Working for Rhys". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gilt-Leaf ambush Rhys and the giants, striking Brion and Kiel with moonglove-poisoned arrows.
timeline.quote: the group was ambushed during their talk by the Gilt-Leaf pursuit commando

citation.text: "Brion Stoutarm", section "Capture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys, Maralen and Ashling free the giants from the nettlevines.
timeline.quote: This was prevented by Rhys, Maralen , and Ashling

citation.text: "Brion Stoutarm", section "Once more in Rhys' service". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The giants tear down the Dauba Ravine bridge and the party finds Rosheen, whose visions are shared.
timeline.quote: The giants helped to tear down the bridge across the Dauba Ravine

citation.text: "Brion Stoutarm", section "Once more in Rhys' service". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brion devastates the elvish party, but Eidren throws moonglove poison into his throat, killing him.
timeline.quote: The caustic poison burned Brion's throat and poisoned him at the same time, suffocating him to death.

citation.text: "Brion Stoutarm", section "Brion's End". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eidren stopped Gryffid from killing the captured Rhys and offered him a deal.

citation.text: "Eidren", section "The capture of Rhys". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys accepted Eidren's offer moments before the Great Aurora struck.

citation.text: "Eidren", section "The capture of Rhys". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sygg carries Rhys's party away on the Wanderwine River.

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid fights Ashling in the Murmuring Bosk and lies to Rhys.

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys duels Nath in the Kinswood and breaks his neck; both are revealed as eyeblights.

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid swears vengeance over Rhys.
timeline.quote: his former friend Gryffid swore vengeance over him

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid and Rhys join forces to rescue Ashling.

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys returns, fights his former tribesmen, kills Nath and drives the elves out of the clachan.
timeline.quote: In the end, he emerged victorious, killing Nath and threatening the rest of the elves out of the clachan.

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Aurora twists Sygg into a cutthroat and makes Rhys a safewright.

citation.text: "Great Aurora", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Kiel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Maralen (Mornsong elf)", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Murmuring Bosk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys cast a powerful spell that destroyed both forces and the valley's life.

citation.text: "Porringer Basin", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A character in the Lorwyn and Morningtide novels whose old mentor was Colfenor.

citation.text: "Flavor Driven". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.
